Nutmeg - a valuable spice

The nutmeg tree, Myristica fragrans, is a large evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia. Until the late 18th century, it only grew in one place in the world: a small group of islands in the Banda Sea, part of the Moluccas – or Spice Islands – in Indonesia...

(Bài đọc sẽ được dán vào đây, có thể xuống dòng bằng ký tự \n)

questions.question: The nutmeg tree is native to ________ Asia.
The nutmeg tree only grew in South America until the 18th century.
